description: Latest U.S. apartment construction numbers for 5+ unit buildings from the Census Bureau (starts, permits, units under construction, completions; seasonally adjusted annual rate, with year-ago and the pipeline peak) and the Federal Reserve's loan officer survey on construction and multifamily lending standards and demand, plus 30-day SOFR. Optional monthly history.

history_months.description: Months of history to include for each Census series (0 to 60). The Fed survey history covers the same span by quarter.
